context: This scene is a communal, undedicated altar in the Stormshore Tabernacle that serves as a conduit for gods who do not yet have their own statues or formal spaces; offerings given here are said to be used to secure those deities a proper place (or otherwise put toward a well‑intentioned purpose). Only a cleric or a character with the proper devotional standing can use the shrine to select a single god at a time to receive coin or a blessing; when a non‑cleric interacts, no deity will present. If the altar has been desecrated by prior player actions, the gods may refuse to answer and deny blessings. Separate, dedicated shrines to gods like Tyr, Mystra, Helm, and Selune exist elsewhere in the tabernacle and provide lore to all visitors and special offering/prayer options to their respective clerics.
